'''''Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War''''' was a 4-part series of comics published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from June 21, [[2000]] to September 20, 2000. The four issues were collected into one [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War (trade paperback)|''Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War'' trade paperback]] in June 2001. The story was retold from the perspective of [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Devaronian Version]]''.
